playkit.bingo.authority.en: Tiles and line progress come from the server. Reward labels describe the configured rewards, not a claim or payout receipt.
playkit.bingo.authority.zh-Hans: 格子与连线进度由服务端返回。奖励文案是配置说明，不代表已兑换或已到账。

playkit.branch.ended.zh-Hans: 已到达这段故事的终点

playkit.camera.gated.en: Camera access is not configured for this session
playkit.camera.gated.zh-Hans: 当前会话尚未配置相机能力

playkit.camera.photoPurpose.en: Take a photo for this task. Nothing is uploaded until you review the separate upload step.
playkit.camera.photoPurpose.zh-Hans: 为当前任务拍摄照片。只有确认单独的上传步骤后才会上传。

playkit.camera.purpose.en: Use the camera for this task?

playkit.camera.scanPurpose.en: Read the task’s QR code with the camera. Review the captured code before sending it for server validation.
playkit.camera.scanPurpose.zh-Hans: 使用相机读取任务二维码。识别后先核对，再发送给服务端验证。

playkit.challenge.authority.en: Start is confirmed by the server first. Local measurements do not award a result or reward.
playkit.challenge.authority.zh-Hans: 先由服务端确认开局。本地测量不代表通过或获得奖励。

playkit.challenge.expired.en: This attempt reached its time limit

playkit.challenge.interrupted.en: The attempt was interrupted. Start again to measure a fresh attempt.
playkit.challenge.interrupted.zh-Hans: 本次尝试已中断，请重新开始计量。

playkit.challenge.measurementOnly.en: This is your device measurement. Submit it for the server’s decision.
playkit.challenge.measurementOnly.zh-Hans: 这是设备测量值，提交后由服务端判定。

playkit.classify.instructions.en: Choose a category for every item. You can change any choice before submitting.
playkit.classify.instructions.zh-Hans: 为每张卡选择一个分类，提交前都可以修改。

playkit.coin.waiting.en: The result will appear after the server responds
playkit.coin.waiting.zh-Hans: 服务端返回后显示结果

playkit.configurationInvalid.en: The task configuration is incomplete. Refresh or return to the task.
playkit.configurationInvalid.zh-Hans: 任务配置不完整，请刷新或返回任务。

playkit.daily.audience.en: Your message may be shown to the next visitor. Completion still depends on the server response.
playkit.daily.audience.zh-Hans: 这句话可能展示给下一位来访者，是否完成以服务端回执为准。

playkit.daily.message.en: Leave a line for the next visitor
playkit.daily.message.zh-Hans: 给下一位来访者留一句

playkit.dice.waiting.en: Dice results have not arrived yet

playkit.discardBoundary.en: Unsubmitted input and this attempt’s local measurements will be discarded. Any already-sent request still needs its server readback.
playkit.discardBoundary.zh-Hans: 未提交的输入和本次本地测量将被清除。已经发出的请求仍需核对服务端结果。

playkit.hidden.boundary.en: Only your chosen position is submitted. Target locations and hit decisions remain on the server.
playkit.hidden.boundary.zh-Hans: 只提交你点选的位置，目标位置与命中判定由服务端保管。

playkit.hidden.hint.en: Tap a location in the image to review that position
playkit.hidden.hint.zh-Hans: 点选图片中的位置后核对提交

playkit.imageGated.en: This task’s image host is not approved yet
playkit.imageGated.zh-Hans: 任务图片来源尚未获准加载

playkit.imageUnavailable.zh-Hans: 图片无法加载，请尝试刷新。

playkit.match.instructions.en: Pair each left item with a right item. Reusing a right item removes its previous pairing.
playkit.match.instructions.zh-Hans: 为每个左侧条目选择一个右侧条目。重复选择同一个右侧条目会解除它原先的配对。

playkit.note.audience.en: This message may be shown to later participants
playkit.note.audience.zh-Hans: 这条留言可能展示给后来的参与者

playkit.pendingBoundary.en: A request is unresolved. New submissions are locked until its exact result is checked or the same request is retried.
playkit.pendingBoundary.zh-Hans: 有请求结果尚未确认。核对结果或重试原请求前，不能发起新提交。

playkit.photo.fallbackRecorded.en: The server recorded a fallback outcome. Its completion state controls the next step.
playkit.photo.fallbackRecorded.zh-Hans: 服务端已记录兜底结果，下一步由服务端完成状态决定。

playkit.photo.frameGuide.en: Framing reference. The native camera framing overlay still requires acceptance.
playkit.photo.frameGuide.zh-Hans: 取景参考。原生相机内的轮廓叠加仍待验收。

playkit.photo.noVerdict.en: No visual-review decision was available for this attempt
playkit.photo.noVerdict.zh-Hans: 这次未能获得视觉审核结论

playkit.photo.serverOnly.en: Only the uploaded image address is submitted. The server performs the visual check; no local score is sent.
playkit.photo.serverOnly.zh-Hans: 仅提交上传后的图片地址。由服务端进行视觉审核，不上报本地分数。

playkit.photo.tooLarge.en: This photo exceeds the 10 MB task upload limit
playkit.photo.tooLarge.zh-Hans: 这张照片超过任务上传的 10 MB 限制

playkit.photo.uploadBoundary.en: The selected image will be sent to the configured service. Uploading is separate from submitting the task and does not complete it.
playkit.photo.uploadBoundary.zh-Hans: 选中的照片将发送给已配置的服务。上传和任务提交是两个步骤，上传不代表完成任务。

playkit.photo.uploadGate.en: Photo upload is not configured, or this photo no longer belongs to the current task version
playkit.photo.uploadGate.zh-Hans: 尚未配置图片上传，或这张照片已不属于当前任务版本

playkit.photo.uploaded.zh-Hans: 照片已上传，任务尚未提交

playkit.predict.lost.en: The server settled this prediction as incorrect

playkit.predict.voided.en: This prediction round was voided; no result reward was issued for the round
playkit.predict.voided.zh-Hans: 本轮竞猜已作废，本轮没有结果奖励

playkit.predict.wait.en: Waiting for the merchant to settle the answer
playkit.predict.wait.zh-Hans: 等待商家公布并结算答案

playkit.predict.won.en: The server settled this prediction as correct

playkit.profile.lockNotice.en: Registration is locked after the server accepts it. Check every answer and the avatar before submitting.
playkit.profile.lockNotice.zh-Hans: 服务端接受后将锁定档案，请在提交前核对所有回答和头像。

playkit.qa.multiHint.en: Select all answers you want to submit
playkit.qa.multiHint.zh-Hans: 选择所有要提交的选项

playkit.reaction.early.en: Too early. This round did not count.
playkit.reaction.early.zh-Hans: 抢跑了，本轮不计入成绩。

playkit.reasoning.serverOnly.en: Only the overall decision comes back from the server. No individual answer is revealed or guessed here.
playkit.reasoning.serverOnly.zh-Hans: 这里只显示服务端的整体判定，不揭露或猜测每一项答案。

playkit.reasoning.tryAgain.en: The last arrangement did not pass. You can revise it while the task remains open.
playkit.reasoning.tryAgain.zh-Hans: 上次排列未通过，任务仍开放时可以修改后重交。

playkit.result.authority.en: Completion and rewards are based only on the server’s returned state
playkit.result.authority.zh-Hans: 是否完成及奖励仅以服务端返回状态为准

playkit.reviewBoundary.en: Check the exact values below. Confirmation sends this action for this session and version; it does not guarantee completion or a reward.
playkit.reviewBoundary.zh-Hans: 请核对下方实际提交值。确认后仅为当前会话和版本发送此动作，不代表一定完成或获得奖励。

playkit.scan.captured.zh-Hans: 已识别二维码，尚未验证

playkit.scan.overlayGate.en: Overlay and AR replies need an approved native renderer. No substitute result is shown.
playkit.scan.overlayGate.zh-Hans: 显形与 AR 回复需要已验收的原生渲染器，当前不展示替代结果。

playkit.sessionChanged.en: Your session changed. Return to the task and reopen it.
playkit.sessionChanged.zh-Hans: 登录会话已变化，请返回任务后重新打开。

playkit.sort.instructions.en: Arrange the items in order. Use the arrow buttons to move an item one place.
playkit.sort.instructions.zh-Hans: 按顺序排列条目，用箭头按钮每次移动一格。

playkit.stopwatch.hidden.en: Elapsed time hidden. Tap stop when you think the target time has arrived.
playkit.stopwatch.hidden.zh-Hans: 计时读数已隐藏，请在你认为到达目标时间时停止。

playkit.type.caseInsensitive.en: Letter case is ignored by the task
playkit.type.caseInsensitive.zh-Hans: 本题不区分英文字母大小写

playkit.type.caseSensitive.zh-Hans: 请保持英文字母大小写一致

playkit.unavailable.en: This task is no longer available

playkit.walk.goalLocked.en: The goal is set by the merchant and cannot be changed here
playkit.walk.goalLocked.zh-Hans: 目标由商家设定，不能在这里修改

playkit.walk.noReading.en: No verified step reading has been returned
playkit.walk.noReading.zh-Hans: 尚未返回经验证的步数

playkit.walk.providerGate.en: The service requires WeChat encrypted step proof. Native device steps cannot replace that proof without an approved contract.
playkit.walk.providerGate.zh-Hans: 当前服务需要微信运动的加密步数凭证。原生设备步数不能在未经契约批准的情况下替代该凭证。

playkit.sensor.purpose.ballShake.en: This activity uses motion readings to move the ball as you tilt your phone and count wall contacts. Keep a firm grip and stay still.
playkit.sensor.purpose.ballShake.zh-Hans: 此玩法使用运动读数，让球随手机倾斜移动并记录撞墙次数。请握稳手机，站在安全的位置。

playkit.sensor.purpose.quietHold.en: This activity uses the microphone to measure ambient peak volume. Keep quiet for the required time after the server confirms the start.
playkit.sensor.purpose.quietHold.zh-Hans: 此玩法使用麦克风测量环境声音峰值。服务器确认开始后，请在要求的时间内保持安静。

playkit.sensor.purpose.shout.en: This activity uses the microphone to measure sustained loudness. Choose a suitable place and a comfortable volume; stop if it feels uncomfortable.
playkit.sensor.purpose.shout.zh-Hans: 此玩法使用麦克风测量持续音量。请选择合适的场所，使用舒适的音量；如有不适请停止。

playkit.sensor.purpose.compass.en: This activity uses the compass to read the magnetic direction of the top of your phone and requires location permission. No location coordinates are read or sent. Hold the phone upright in portrait and keep it aligned with the target.
playkit.sensor.purpose.compass.zh-Hans: 此玩法使用罗盘读取手机顶部的磁北方位角，需要位置权限，但不会读取或发送位置坐标。请竖屏握住手机并持续对准目标方向。

playkit.sensor.audioPrivacy.en: Only peak volume is measured. Audio is never saved or uploaded.
playkit.sensor.audioPrivacy.zh-Hans: 仅测量声音峰值，不保存或上传音频。

playkit.compass.caution.en: Indoor magnetic interference can make the compass inaccurate. This reading is not proof of arrival.
playkit.compass.caution.zh-Hans: 室内磁场干扰可能造成罗盘偏差。此读数不能作为到店凭证。

playkit.sensor.error.configurationUnavai.en: This sensor activity is not enabled for this build.
playkit.sensor.error.configurationUnavai.zh-Hans: 此版本尚未启用该传感器玩法。

playkit.sensor.error.permissionDenied.en: Sensor permission was denied. You can change it in system Settings, then try again.
playkit.sensor.error.permissionDenied.zh-Hans: 传感器权限被拒绝。您可以在系统设置中修改权限后重试。

playkit.sensor.error.sensorUnavailable.en: The required sensor is unavailable on this device.
playkit.sensor.error.sensorUnavailable.zh-Hans: 此设备无法使用所需的传感器。

playkit.sensor.error.interrupted.en: This attempt was interrupted. Start again when you are ready.
playkit.sensor.error.interrupted.zh-Hans: 本次尝试已中断。准备好后请重新开始。

playkit.sensor.error.missingSamples.en: Fresh sensor readings stopped or were invalid. No missing time was counted. Please try again.
playkit.sensor.error.missingSamples.zh-Hans: 实时传感器读数已停止或无效。未计入缺失时段，请重试。

playkit.sensor.phase.calibrating.zh-Hans: 正在使用实时读数校准

playkit.sensor.phase.measured.zh-Hans: 测量结果已就绪，请核对

playkit.ball.calibration.en: Hold the phone in your starting position for 1.2 seconds.
playkit.ball.calibration.zh-Hans: 请将手机保持在起始姿势 1.2 秒。

playkit.audio.calibration.en: Keep the surroundings typical and steady while we measure two seconds of background sound.
playkit.audio.calibration.zh-Hans: 测量环境音的两秒内，请保持环境声音自然、稳定。

playkit.sensor.measuredBoundary.en: This is a device measurement. Only the server can accept it and determine the result.
playkit.sensor.measuredBoundary.zh-Hans: 这是设备测量结果。是否接受以及最终结果均由服务器决定。

playkit.sensor.startBoundary.en: The challenge will start only after the server acknowledges your reviewed request.
playkit.sensor.startBoundary.zh-Hans: 核对请求并获得服务器确认后，挑战才会开始。

playkit.sensor.calibrate.zh-Hans: 检查传感器权限并校准

playkit.ball.instruction.en: Tilt gently to move the ball into the edges.
playkit.ball.instruction.zh-Hans: 轻轻倾斜手机，让球碰到边缘。

playkit.quiet.limitReached.en: A sound crossed the limit. The measured hold has ended.
playkit.quiet.limitReached.zh-Hans: 声音超过阈值，本次保持测量已结束。

playkit.shout.continuous.en: Keep the volume above the limit continuously. A drop resets the hold.
playkit.shout.continuous.zh-Hans: 请持续保持音量超过阈值。音量下降会将保持时间清零。

playkit.compass.lowAccuracy.en: Heading accuracy is too low. Move away from magnetic interference.
playkit.compass.lowAccuracy.zh-Hans: 方位精度不足，请远离磁场干扰。

playkit.compass.waitingHeading.en: Waiting for an actual compass reading
playkit.compass.waitingHeading.zh-Hans: 正在等待真实罗盘读数

playkit.compare.instructions.en: Compare both records and mark every missing or changed entry. You can select entries from either timeline.
playkit.compare.instructions.zh-Hans: 对照两份记录，标出所有缺失或被改动的条目，可从任一侧多选。

playkit.compare.correct.en: The server marked the complete selection correct.
playkit.compare.correct.zh-Hans: 服务端判定整组标记正确。

playkit.compare.incorrect.en: The server marked the complete selection incorrect. Individual answers are not revealed.
playkit.compare.incorrect.zh-Hans: 服务端判定整组标记有误，不揭示单条答案。

playkit.compare.changed.en: The session has changed. Your selection has not been submitted for this version. Load the latest receipt before editing again.
playkit.compare.changed.zh-Hans: 会话版本已更新，当前选择未针对新版本提交。继续编辑前请载入最新回执。

playkit.compare.reloadQuestion.en: Replace your unsent selection with the server’s last recorded selection?
playkit.compare.reloadQuestion.zh-Hans: 用服务端最近记录的选择替换未提交的选择？

playkit.compare.invalid.en: The comparison question is incomplete or inconsistent. Refresh the server state before continuing.
playkit.compare.invalid.zh-Hans: 对照题数据不完整或不一致，请刷新服务端状态后继续。

playkit.compare.reviewBoundary.en: These exact entries will be submitted together. One submission is recorded; only the server decides the result.
playkit.compare.reviewBoundary.zh-Hans: 将一起提交以下条目并计作一次作答，结果仅由服务端判定。

playkit.compare.none.en: No entries marked. Submitting still counts as an attempt.
playkit.compare.none.zh-Hans: 未标记任何条目，提交仍计作一次作答。

playkit.type.retry.en: The last attempt did not pass. You can try again.
playkit.type.retry.zh-Hans: 上次尝试未通过，可以再试一次。

playkit.type.finishedNotPassed.en: This round has ended without passing.
